name: Forty Pillars Mining Corp.
summary: Forty Pillars Mining Corp. is a Canadian entity primarily focused on the exploration and discovery of mineral resources. The company's search efforts target valuable deposits of gold, silver, lead, and zinc across various sites in Canada. Key among its assets, Forty Pillars Mining Corp. possesses complete ownership of the Silver Dollar property. This substantial holding in British Columbia's Revelstoke Mining District comprises 28 continuous mineral claims spanning 3,344.68 hectares, supplemented by two Crown grants totaling 41.85 hectares. The company also fully owns the Beatrice Mineral Property, which is likewise located in British Columbia. Expanding its portfolio, Forty Pillars Mining Corp. holds an exclusive option to acquire full ownership of ten additional mineral claims, situated within British Columbia's Liard Mining Division. Founded in 2021, the corporation is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
